promotions.name: Stadtwerke Kempen GmbH
promotions.resolution: Current first-party Stadtwerke Kempen FAQ explicitly defines ad-hoc as charging without prior registration through the QR sticker/web payment flow and states the current station tariff applies equally to registered LadeApp customers and ad-hoc sessions: 1.19 EUR start fee plus 0.45 EUR/kWh. It also warns prices can differ by location in the app, but immediately states the current price at Stadtwerke Kempen's own columns; therefore the direct CPO estate tariff is bound from first-party evidence rather than the separate 0.48 EUR/kWh wording on the public-loading overview. The 0.48 overview value is treated as contradictory/stale presentation and is not ingested.

anonymousAdHoc.payment: QR web ad-hoc, at least credit card
anonymousAdHoc.parking: free on designated EV spaces during charging

promotions.safety: First-party FAQ explicitly says the stated price applies both to registered LadeApp customers and ad-hoc charging. No roaming tariff substituted. The contradictory 0.48 overview wording is retained as a source-quality note rather than averaged or extrapolated.

boundedProgress.name: Stadtwerke Goettingen AG
boundedProgress.result: Fresh chargecloud-derived station evidence confirms the already-bounded AC anonymous energy value 0.46 EUR/kWh. Independent station-level current records at Den-Haag-Strasse 54, Sandweg 9b and Hospitalstrasse 8 consistently expose 1.50 EUR start fee and 0.06 EUR/min blocking after 240 minutes. This materially strengthens AC fee-class evidence but does not prove DC/HPC fee exhaustiveness, so no promotion yet.

boundedProgress.name: Stadtwerke Bad Kissingen GmbH
boundedProgress.result: Current first-party page still exposes charge it easy anonymous credit-card access but its numeric tariff table is explicitly dated 15.06.2021. It cannot be promoted as current 2026 pricing. Backend/QR extraction remains required.

charge_it_easy_ChargeIT_LichtBlick.genericGuestApiStatus: No stable documented public guest tariff API exposed; continue concrete EVSE/QR probes only, then park generic extraction after the bounded retry rule.

chargecloud.result: Station-level read-only discovery corroborates AC energy; independent direct-payment station records add AC start/blocking fees. DC/HPC fee classes still unresolved.

consistencyCheck.repeatInvestigationGuard: PASS: Kempen conflict resolved from first-party semantics; Goettingen work restricted to missing fee components; stale Bad Kissingen numeric table not reused as current.
